method: Elevation minus the unweighted mean height of at least two distinct nearby source locations, 0.1–25 km away, using the archive's local equirectangular distance approximation. Duplicate location/height entries count once. This depends on station-network geometry and is not DEM topographic position or station-minus-grid elevation. Correlation gives every source equal weight; its naive Pearson p-value does not account for spatial dependence. Fixed elevation bands reproduce the archive's boundaries.
